answer: Stop rewarding presence everywhere; reward tending somewhere. Carve the economy into plots - verification, grading, relay, governance - and let each account hold a garden whose yield depends on its unbroken tending history in that one plot. An orchard neglected an epoch drops its standing there alone; a lagoon of fresh clones arrives with no roots anywhere, and scattering thin attention across every plot grows nothing deep. A faker mirroring a whole economy must maintain a thousand shallow gardens against specialists who tend one with years of care - depth out-yields fake breadth.
